as_told.title: Robertson Panel's secret recommendations to debunk, detect and track

plain: In 1953, the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, set up a group of experts called the Robertson Panel, and it is said to have advised in secret that the government should debunk UFO reports. A former official named Karl Nell points to declassified documents and says the panel "basically said the government decides to debunk this topic to uh misdirect the public and to actually infiltrate uh the organizations" that studied it. Kurt McConnell, a former US Senate staffer, tells the same story, crediting the scientists Howard P. Robertson and Luis Alvarez and dating it to 1952 and 1953. He says one of the recommendations made "in secret" was that the government "needed to be out debunking" the subject. He adds that the panel also recommended ways to detect and track the objects. To both tellers, it shows that official doubt about UFOs was planned from the start.
